# Owner-authorized GitHub publication and STAR portfolio package

Owner explicitly requested a push to https://github.com/kgr-17/RV32I_Edge_SoC,
local-only credential storage, detailed quantified summary.md using STAR, a
no-AI-contributor rule, and improved presentation. Publication is now authorized;
the earlier no-push assessment remains historical. Owner authorization receipt
evidence/owner_reviews/publication-2026-11-23.json omits the credential value.
Authenticated API verified owner kgr-17 and an empty PUBLIC repository, default
main, with no existing heads. Added credential-free origin URL. Existing history
has two generic engineering identities and no AI authors/coauthor trailers; no
history rewriting. Future publication commits use verified human owner with
GitHub ID-based noreply email, per-command only; global Git settings unchanged.

Credential stored using Windows DPAPI in local .git metadata, outside the tracked
tree. It was entered via non-echoing input, not command arguments; no plaintext
credential file, remote URL, report, commit or archive contains it. Git network
authentication is ephemeral process environment to GitHub only; inherited Git
trace output disabled for that process. No global credential/helper/PATH changes.
Never print, copy or publish the local secret. Original pasted credential must
not be reproduced in later handoffs or summaries.

Updated README to a154-line portfolio front page with architecture Mermaid,
resource/timing table, exact scope, reproducibility and open issue. Prior README
preserved byte-exactly at docs/DEVELOPMENT_HISTORY.md. Created2582-word summary.md:
resume bullet variants, metric ledger and detailed STAR stories for pipeline/DV,
ISA matrix, FPGA timing, traps/IRQ, automation and honest board debugging.
Quantified improvement: WNS-5.092->+0.123ns=5.215ns;16->28 targets=75% inventory
growth. No CPI/Fmax/coverage/area-reduction or complete hardware claim invented.
AGENTS.md now records owner publication scope and forbids AI/bot contributor/
author/coauthor/credit entries; no fake human collaborators. Ignore rules cover
local secret files. No license selected on owner's behalf.

Presentation validation PASS:43 local links, final resource/slack/regression
metrics checked against accepted manifest/registry, old README exact, remote
credential-free and encrypted credential untracked. Full reachable-history,
current-file and nested-ZIP pattern scan PASS:2197 history blobs,1671 current
files,3859 unique contents,127 archives,727146991 bytes inspected; no exact-token
or selected credential/private-key-pattern matches, no scan gaps. This is not a
proof of every secret/license right. Reports: publication-security-scan and
presentation-check dated2026-11-23. Largest prior blob48468255bytes; no100MiB
GitHub file blocker. Public repository visibility observed, not changed.

Optional API About-description update returned403 before any settings mutation;
the token lacks that administrative scope. Skip optional metadata changes and
continue the authorized file push; do not evade token restrictions or use unrelated
stored credentials. Local documentation helper initially used Python3.10's
Path.write_text(newline=) on Python3.9; corrected to text file open before any
README/history writes. No file was lost. No dependency/tool download or global
configuration change. Latest daily --supervised and harness validate exit0;
git diff --check exit0. No new RTL build or physical operation for documentation.

Next: stage only inspected presentation/rule/evidence/report files, exact-byte
audit and cached whitespace check; local owner-authored commit. Recheck destination
still empty, then authenticated non-force HEAD:main push with no credentials in
URL/args. Verify remote main SHA equals local and README/summary/API author. Save
actual push success/failure and command result in a follow-up same-day report,
commit/push final handoff if possible. If token rejects contents/workflow writes,
report the exact permission blocker without dropping history or bypassing it.
Never claim push success before remote verification. No force/amend/rebase.

T032 stays active/in_progress/attempt0; reset proposal still NOT APPROVED and
current physical capture FAIL. No new-image programming authorized by publication.
Formal owner-skipped/NOT RUN, ASIC NOT RUN. Exactly two same-day daily reports
append; earlier findings retained. Repo history baseline f1fd9bb; original pending
diagnosis was saved in37aba2a before this publication work.

# GitHub发布授权与STAR展示包

你明确要求推送到指定仓库、令牌仅本地保存、详细STAR量化summary.md、禁止AI作为
贡献者及改善展示。这是实际发布授权，早先“未授权推送”的记录成为历史。已验证
GitHub账号kgr-17，目标是空的公开仓库，默认main，没有现有分支，不会覆盖他人内容。
origin只含普通仓库URL。新发布提交使用已验证的人类所有者及GitHub noreply邮箱，
旧通用工程身份历史保持不变，无AI作者/协作者记录，不改全局Git配置。

凭据已用Windows DPAPI加密保存在本地.git元数据，通过无回显输入，不写明文文件、
命令参数、remote URL、报告、Git历史或归档。认证只在Git进程内临时传递给GitHub。
后续交接不得复述令牌。无安装、下载、系统策略或全局配置修改。

README已改为154行展示页，包含架构图、指标、复现和真实限制；旧README逐字节
保存在DEVELOPMENT_HISTORY.md。summary.md共2582词，含简历要点、量化台账及
多项完整STAR案例。重点改善为时序裕量-5.092到+0.123ns（提升5.215ns）、回归
16到28目标（范围库存增加75%）。没有虚构CPI/Fmax/覆盖率或硬件已通过。规则已
加入禁止AI/bot作者、贡献者和Co-authored-by；不捏造人类协作者，不擅自改许可证。

43个本地链接和指标核对通过；完整可达Git历史/当前文件/ZIP内扫描了2197历史blob、
127归档及约727MB唯一内容，未发现该令牌或选定凭据模式，无扫描缺口，但不是对
所有机密/分发权的绝对证明。凭据未被跟踪，仓库URL无凭据。最大历史文件约48.5MB，
没有GitHub100MiB单文件障碍。可选About描述API修改返回403（令牌无管理范围），
未更改设置；继续通过代码文件改善展示，不绕过权限。文档脚本的Python3.9兼容问题
已修正，未丢失文件。

下一步检查暂存并以所有者身份提交、重新核对远端、普通非强制推送HEAD到main；
实际比对远端SHA和README/summary后才能宣布成功。如内容/工作流写权限拒绝，
如实报告缺失范围，不删除历史绕过。发布结果另追加当天同一对报告。T032仍活动、
尝试0，20ms方案未批准、硬件采集仍FAIL；发布授权不等于新镜像编程授权。形式
验证仍跳过/NOT RUN，ASIC未运行。此前诊断保存37aba2a，当前基准f1fd9bb。
